Egyptian retail sales analysis

An interactive Power BI report built from 8,000 orders across five Egyptian regions and six product categories, Jan 2024 to Aug 2026.

Total sales97.56M
Total profit20.60M
Profit margin21.12%
Avg order12.20K
Orders8K

All amounts in EGP.

The problem

The business had over two years of order data but no single view of performance. It couldn't clearly answer which categories, products, regions and customers drive sales and profit, or how many orders are lost to returns and cancellations.

How I solved it

  1. Cleaned and prepared the dataFixed data types, missing values and duplicates, and standardized region, category and status fields.
  2. Wrote DAX measuresTotal sales, total profit, profit margin %, average order value and order counts.
  3. Built a three-page reportAn overview, a drill-down with year, region and category filters, and an insights page.
  4. Turned findings into recommendationsFour clear actions the business can take.

Explore the data

Key findings

  1. Electronics is the main revenue driver.It leads both sales and profit. Prioritize stock and marketing for top electronics while growing weaker categories.
  2. Upper Egypt leads all regions.About 35M EGP in sales, well ahead of Delta (23M). Study what works there and test it in other regions.
  3. Revenue depends on a few products.The top 3 products bring in over half of sales. Protect their availability and promote others to reduce risk.
  4. Only about half of orders are delivered.4.02K of 8K orders. Investigate return and cancellation reasons to improve completion.
